justifications.durability: tests/test_fragment_ids_are_checked.py fails at base eff21542c (four cases: the two collision refusals and both cleanly-prefixed passes), so the new assertions are red before the change and green after; the refusal cases also assert the inherited measure/scope collisions are not named in the finding.
justifications.evidence: the gate log logs/head-gate.log records 6 passed EXIT=0 at the worktree; logs/negative-control-eff21542c.log records 4 failed EXIT=1 at eff21542c, which is on main after the regression commit 3dd7356fc (verified ancestor of eff21542c); logs/population-base.log and logs/population-head.log record 711 passed / 0 failed each.
justifications.fit: reckon/doccheck.py:1391-1393 adds the _fragment_source_label helper beside the composition reader it labels so the fragment label is spelled in one place, and the keyword-only changed_fragments parameter defaults to None so the audit-doc caller at reckon/doccheck.py:1573 keeps the whole-record behaviour unchanged.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/reports.py:1838-1848 audits each changed fragment's plan and passes changed_fragments through to doccheck.audit_composed_record_ids and doccheck.audit_fragment_ids, so only a duplicate one of whose occurrences lies in the run's own fragment is reported; reckon/doccheck.py:1458-1466 filters duplicates by origin against the authored fragment labels.
justifications.scope_discipline: commit 738d1db02 changes only reckon/crew/reports.py, reckon/doccheck.py and tests/test_fragment_ids_are_checked.py, and commit cbf08f977 adds only docs/evidence/fragments/crew-observability-truth/a-fragment-check-names-only-the-runs-collisions.html; all four paths are in the manifest's declared changed_paths.
